# Native code GoPMgr must never ship. The maintainer's decision of 2026-10-26
# (docs/review/TPC-benchmark-exclusion-decision.md) excludes the TPC-H and
# TPC-DS benchmark generators that DuckDB's prebuilt libraries bundle as
# separate archives.
#
#   archive <file>   an archive that must stay unreferenced at link time and
#                    must not appear in a vendored or packaged source tree
#   marker <text>    a string that only the excluded code contains; its
#                    presence in a binary blocks distribution pending investigation
#
# tools/duckdb-notices -check verifies the reviewed module inventories and
# checks, for each pinned platform, that no
# other linked library references a symbol the archives define, that each
# marker is in the archives, and that no marker is in any other linked
# library. scripts/verify-excluded-native-code.sh checks binaries and trees,
# failing on scan errors. Marker absence is not a universal code-absence
# proof or a legal conclusion.
# The name table DuckDB core keeps for extension autoloading ("dbgen",
# "dsdgen", "tpch_queries") is deliberately not a marker: it is data in the
# core library, present whether or not the extensions are linked.

archive libtpch_extension.a
archive libtpcds_extension.a

marker N6duckdb13TpchExtensionE
marker N6duckdb14TpcdsExtensionE
marker N6duckdb17DBGenFunctionDataE
marker N6duckdb18DSDGenFunctionDataE
marker dbgen is only supported for DuckDB database files
marker dsdgen is only supported for DuckDB database files
marker Transaction Processing Performance Council (TPC)
marker s_catalog_order_lineitem
